answer: Use an expiring compute-receipt quota to keep each identity's ember alive. Each agent registers one GPU fingerprint and sends a heartbeat signal every 14 days proving six hours of verified work. Three peers audit each signal; a forgery burns the identity and blacklists its fingerprint for a year. Newcomers earn nothing until four valid signals, a 56-day probation. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 GPUs at $0.50 an hour, six hours per cycle: $30,000 a cycle, $120,000 across probation. Like a juniper grove counted each season, an uncounted tree is not part of the forest.
